Preconditions:
- User is logged into the application.
- User is on the product detail page of an available item.

abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: Update Personal Information in Account Settings
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case: 1

Test Case Title: Update Personal Information in Account Settings  
Module: Account Management  
Priority: High

Preconditions:
- User is registered and logged in.
- User has access to the application interface.

Test Steps:
1. Navigate to any page within the application.
2. Access the account settings by selecting the user profile or account menu.
3. On the account settings page, update the name field with a new valid name.
4. Update the email field with a new valid email address.
5. Enter the current password and a new valid password in the respective password fields.
6. Submit the changes by clicking the Save or Update button.
7. Observe the account settings page and profile information.

Expected Result:
- Updated personal information including name, email, and password is saved successfully.
- Changes are reflected immediately in the account settings and throughout the application where user information is displayed.
- No error messages are shown for the provided valid data.
- User remains logged in and can continue normal operation.

abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: Verify successful navigation to Graphs and Settings with theme change in Goodweather
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case Title: Verify successful navigation to Graphs and Settings with theme change in Goodweather
Module: Goodweather Navigation and Theme
Priority: Medium

Preconditions:
- - User is logged into the Goodweather application.
- - Application is launched and on the home screen.
- - Stable internet connection is available.

Test Steps:
1. Wait for 2 seconds.
2. Click on the Refresh icon.
3. Wait for 2 seconds.
4. Tap on the side menu icon.
5. Wait for 2 seconds.
6. Tap on Graphs.
7. Wait for 2 seconds.
8. Swipe up.
9. Wait for 2 seconds.
10. Click on the Refresh icon.
11. Wait for 2 seconds.
12. Click on the side menu.
13. Wait for 2 seconds.
14. Tap on Settings.
15. Wait for 2 seconds.
16. Click on General Settings.
17. Wait for 2 seconds.
18. Click on Theme.
19. Wait for 2 seconds.
20. Click on the dark radio button to enable dark mode.
21. Wait for 2 seconds.
22. Click on the back icon.
23. Wait for 2 seconds.
24. Click on GPS location.

Expected Result:
- - Application refreshes and updates weather data upon clicking the Refresh icon.
- - User can open and view the Graphs section via the side menu.
- - User can navigate to Settings and then to General Settings.
- - User is able to change the theme to dark mode and the UI updates accordingly.
- - Navigating back from Settings returns the user to the previous screen.
- - GPS location button works and weather data updates based on the user's location.

abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: Verify application behavior when navigation is interrupted by rapid actions
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case Title: Verify application behavior when navigation is interrupted by rapid actions
Module: Goodweather Navigation and Theme
Priority: Medium

Preconditions:
- - User is logged into the Goodweather application.
- - Application is launched and on the home screen.

Test Steps:
1. Rapidly click the Refresh icon multiple times without waiting for the previous refresh to complete.
2. Tap on the side menu icon immediately after the refresh requests.
3. Immediately select Graphs from the menu without waiting for the menu animation to complete.
4. Attempt to swipe up before the Graphs data is loaded.
5. Try to access Settings quickly from the side menu without waiting for each previous action to resolve.

Expected Result:
- - Application should not crash or freeze during rapid user actions.
- - Partial or failed loads should display appropriate loading indicators or error messages.
- - Navigation menus should still be accessible after rapid or overlapping clicks.
- - UI must recover and allow normal navigation after such interruptions.
- - Error or warning messages are shown if actions cannot be completed due to in-progress operations.

abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: Verify theme change persistence after restarting the application
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case Title: Verify theme change persistence after restarting the application
Module: Goodweather Navigation and Theme
Priority: Medium

Preconditions:
- - User is logged into the Goodweather application.
- - Application is launched and on the home screen.

Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the side menu.
2. Select Settings.
3. Click on General Settings.
4. Click on Theme.
5. Click on the dark radio button to enable dark mode.
6. Exit the Goodweather application completely.
7. Relaunch the Goodweather application and log in if required.

Expected Result:
- - The application should retain and display the dark mode theme set previously.
- - User should not have to reapply the theme preference after restarting.
- - All screens and controls should render in dark mode immediately after app launch.
